scorecard.outcome: Revenue grew 10% in Jun 2026 and 12% in Sep 2026 (Q1/Q2 FY27), exceeding high single-digits.

scorecard.outcome: Management confirmed in Nov 2026 that the transaction remains on track for Q4 FY27.

credibility.summary: Management consistently meets or exceeds revenue growth targets. Most strategic promises involve long-term M&A and R&D cycles that remain on track according to repeated updates.

narrative_vs_numbers: Revenue growth numbers (10-12%) are currently outperforming the 'high single-digit' narrative provided in May 2026.
Operating margins remain stable at 29% in FY27, aligning with the 28-29% historical performance levels.
Reported PAT in Sep 2026 (1995 Cr) shows a sharp drop versus adjusted profit (31620 Mn), reflecting non-recurring items.
